subject: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation

Team —

We have three overlapping renewal windows coming up for developer productivity tooling: GitHub Enterprise (GHE) renewal 11/15, JetBrains renewals staggered between 11/20–12/05, and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) on 12/01. Procurement flagged potential cost savings if we consolidate negotiations and lock in multi-vendor discounts.

I attached our current license inventory (20260901_current_licenses_summary.xlsx). Please review the counts and highlight any upcoming org changes that would affect seat counts (SRE hiring tranche, new infra team).

Immediate asks:
- Ben: can you reach out to GitHub and JetBrains reps this week to solicit consolidated discount terms? Ask for firm quotes and any flex on start/end date alignment.
- Karthik: confirm whether Legal prefers staggered renewals or a single master PO for potential accounting implications.
- Marissa: prepared to route PO once terms are finalized — confirm internal budget owner and approval flow.

Goal: agree a negotiation cadence and target consolidated renewal window by Friday 9/4 so vendor conversations start next week.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of IT Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260901_current_licenses_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: rows with product, sku, seats, current_term_end)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation

Olga / team —

I pinged the three vendor contacts this morning. High-level update:

- GitHub (enterprise-sales@github.com): rep is open to a 12–18 month enterprise agreement extension to align windows, quoted list pricing reduction of ~12% for a 12-month commit and another 3% for +10% seats expansion flexibility. Asked for a consolidated quote by EOD Tue 9/8.

- JetBrains (licensing@jetbrains.com): licensing rep says they can move our renewal date by up to 30 days to align; multi-product discount scales with seat count. They requested our seat counts per team (see attached) and will provide a workbook.

- Atlassian (am@atlassian.com): slower response; AM suggests a multi-year lock with an enterprise support add-on. They asked for annual spend and current SKUs; promised initial numbers by next week.

Next steps I took: asked GitHub and JetBrains for quotes with the option to include Atlassian in a consolidated signature (we may need Legal signoff). Also asked for any one-time migration credits (e.g., GitHub Actions runner credits) we can negotiate.

I attached my note with the vendor contact names and the spreadsheet I sent (copied from your inventory).

-Ben
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260903_vendor_outreach_note.docx (doc stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation

Thanks team — short note from Legal/Finance perspective:

- Finance prefers to avoid many small POs across months; a single PO that spans multiple suppliers is unusual from accounting perspective and complicates supplier reconciliation.
- Legal is fine with aligning effective dates where vendors permit, but wants separate master agreements for each vendor (standard).
- For approval flow, draft PO goes to Marissa (Proc Ops) > Finance Controller (A. Wallace) > CTO (for spend > $200k).

Recommendation: pursue aligned effective dates where possible, but plan to execute separate vendor contracts and consolidate at the purchase order (PO) and budget owner level only. That preserves Finance/AR flows.

If vendors offer a bundled discount that requires single-contract signature, escalate to me and Legal will review.

Karthik
Director, IT & Security
Redwood Inference

From: GitHub Sales <enterprise-sales@github.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: JetBrains Licensing <licensing@jetbrains.com>, Atlassian Account Manager <am@atlassian.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:42:00Z
Subject: RE: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation

Hi Ben / Olga —

Thanks for the outreach and the seat summary. Attached is a consolidated quote that reflects a coordinated renewal approach (we prepared it to show how discounts scale by combining commit windows). Highlights:

- GitHub portion: 12% standard discount on current list, +3% if total seat commitment grows by 10% across the org.
- Proposed alignment: start date 2026-11-15 for GitHub and suggested effective alignment for JetBrains to 2026-11-20; Atlassian would remain 2026-12-01 but we can apply a timing credit.
- One-time credits: 2500 GitHub Actions minutes and $10k migration credit if Redwood signs within 30 days.

We attached a combined PDF (20260906_combined_quote.pdf) with line items and a redlined optional schedule for coordinated start/end dates. If this looks promising we can convert to DocuSign and include signature blocks for JetBrains and Atlassian reps as needed.

Best,
Claire Mendes
Strategic Accounts — GitHub
enterprise-sales@github.com

Attachment: 20260906_combined_quote.pdf (quote stub: line items, term, discounts, credits)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Subscription sync: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian renewal windows and consolidation

All —

Reviewed the GitHub consolidated quote. Finance confirmed budget capacity if we lock the 12% + 3% seat growth option and accept the $10k migration credit (net impact positive). Legal asks for standard vendor schedules per Karthik's guidance.

Action items I completed:
- Prepared PO template and routed to Finance Controller for preliminary approval.
- Opened DocuSign envelope with GitHub (clause for separate vendor agreements and a schedule for JetBrains/Atlassian). Link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/abcd-efgh-2026
- Added procurement Jira ticket for tracking: PROC-412 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-412).

Next steps: Claire (GitHub) — please confirm who will be the signatory for the combined DocuSign (we need names and emails for JetBrains and Atlassian contacts). Once we have that, I'll finalize PO and hit send.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260907_PO_Redwood-1234.pdf (PO stub: PO number Redwood-1234, budget center, approval chain)
